_comment: Copy to config.json. Wired for the BypassHormuz daily briefing pipeline: AIMLAPI for LLM + STT, Pixabay stock footage for visuals, and the published podcast MP3 as the voiceover (no TTS spend).
_visuals: stock keeps marginal cost at zero and suits a news briefing better than AI art. Switch asset_strategy to mixed and set an image provider if you want generated frames.
_audio: The voiceover comes from https://bypasshormuz.com/podcast/audio/{date}.mp3 via PrerecordedTTS, so tts_provider is never used by this pipeline.
_subtitles: script_based uses the exact transcript we already hold, so no second STT pass is needed at render time.
